STRONGLY_RISING.conditions: demand_momentum >= 75 AND augmentation_potential >= automation_exposure AND (policy_priority >= 75 OR persistent_critical == True)

MIXED_UNCERTAIN.conditions: unresolved_conflict == True OR confidence == INSUFFICIENT OR sensitive_to_perturbation == True

DECLINING.conditions: automation_exposure > augmentation_potential AND (dropped_from_mycol == True OR wage_momentum < 40)

STRONGLY_DECLINING.conditions: automation_exposure >= 2.5 * augmentation_potential AND dropped_from_mycol == True AND wage_momentum < 35

conflict_taxonomy.CROSS_DIMENSION_TENSION: Simultaneous high demand and high AI exposure where augmentation dominates.
conflict_taxonomy.WITHIN_DIMENSION_CONFLICT: Direct contradiction between two sources evaluating the same dimension.
conflict_taxonomy.CONFLICT_PRESENT_RESOLVED: Tension recognized and reconciled via explicit domain rules.
conflict_taxonomy.CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED: Unreconciled contradiction causing downgrade to MIXED / UNCERTAIN.
